name: Lakes
summary: Lagos is the economic and technological powerhouse of West Africa, with a remarkably low cost of living and a thriving fintech ecosystem centered on Yaba, nicknamed 'Silicon Lagoon'. Cultural life is vibrant and beaches like Lekki offer weekend getaways, although traffic is extreme, power cuts are frequent and it is worth choosing your neighborhood carefully (Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikoyi). Fiber internet has improved greatly recently, although the national average speed remains moderate.
